outcome: The general abundance conjecture for klt projective varieties over the classical (characteristic 0) setting in arbitrary dimension remains open, but several restricted cases were settled after 26 January 2024: Liu–Xu (arXiv:2505.05250, May 2025) proved abundance for klt/lc projective varieties in dimension ≤5 whenever κ≥0 and the numerical dimension ν≤1, and separately showed non-vanishing implies abundance in that numerical-dimension range in all dimensions; positive- and mixed-characteristic threefold cases (ν=2, char>3) and a Kähler-variety reduction strategy (dimension 4) also advanced, but these are either pre-window results with post-window arXiv revisions, or address a different ambient category (Kähler, not projective) or singularity class (slc, not klt).

disputes.summary: Swapnajit Das's arXiv:2604.28085 (submitted 2026-04-30) originally (v1) claimed a counterexample to abundance for compact Kähler slc threefolds. János Kollár pointed out the proposed counterexample admits an étale double cover with sdlt singularities, contradicting the v1 claims. The revised v2 (2026-09-13) instead proves abundance DOES hold for all compact Kähler slc threefolds (a positive result), and relocates the counterexample to non-Kähler varieties in Fujiki class C with slc (not klt) singularities. This is a withdrawn-then-corrected claim, but concerns slc singularities on a broader (non-Kähler, Fujiki class C) category, not the klt/projective statement in this bullet, so it does not itself change this problem's status.

summary: The Wikipedia statement is the general abundance conjecture: for a projective variety with klt singularities, K nef implies K semiample, in arbitrary dimension, classical (char 0) setting. This remains open in general — every source consulted (Wikipedia's own article, ProofAtlas, and every paper found) agrees the unrestricted higher-dimensional conjecture is unproved. Genuine post-window progress on CASES of the stated conjecture exists: Liu and Xu (arXiv:2505.05250, v1 2025-05-08, v2 2025-07-30) prove that the non-vanishing conjecture implies abundance whenever the numerical dimension ν≤1, and unconditionally settle abundance (in the lc case, using a refinement from Lazić–Peternell) for projective varieties of dimension ≤5 with κ≥0 and ν≤1 — a genuine, narrower case of the stated conjecture, classified `partial`/`confirmed`. Several other candidate results turned out NOT to be cases of the klt/projective statement: (1) the positive-characteristic threefold ν=2 result (arXiv:2307.03938) and the mixed-characteristic threefold result (arXiv:2111.08970) both had their substantive claims already made before the window (v1 2023-07 and v1 2021-11 respectively, the latter with no revision after 2022-11); their post-window arXiv revisions (v3 2026-04-17, publication-ready polish) do not add new mathematical content, so these are `open_stale` as individual events and are not used to date the record's status. (2) The Kähler-threefold log-abundance completion (Höring/Peternell-adjacent work, arXiv:2306.00671) for ν=2 was already claimed in v1 (2023-06-01), predating the window, and in any case Kähler (not necessarily projective) is a different ambient category from the Wikipedia statement, and an April 2023 erratum (arXiv:2304.10161, pre-window) had flagged a genuine gap in the underlying Campana–Höring–Peternell theorem that is not fully closed by that paper alone. (3) The April 2026 Kähler-variety reduction strategy (arXiv:2604.03879) explicitly reduces the Kähler case to the projective case and only settles some non-algebraic/trivial-K_X fourfold cases — a related-problem variant (different category), not a case of the stated klt/projective conjecture. (4) The 2026-04/09 slc-Kähler-threefold episode (arXiv:2604.28085, see `disputes`) concerns slc singularities, a strictly larger and different singularity class than klt, and after correction resolves positively for Kähler slc threefolds while placing the only counterexample in non-Kähler Fujiki class C — again a related problem, not this bullet's question. No source anywhere — not the papers themselves, not their arXiv listings, not searches crossing this problem with DeepMind/AlphaProof/AlphaEvolve/GPT/Claude/Lean formalization benchmarks (including the 'Formal Conjectures' DeepMind benchmark paper, arXiv:2605.13171, whose full text contains zero occurrences of the word 'abundance') — credits any AI system with any role in this problem. `ai_role` is therefore `none`.
competing_reading: One could argue the Liu–Xu fivefold result is narrow enough (a specific dimension bound and numerical-dimension restriction) that it barely moves 'what a careful person would write in this bullet's entry,' making `progress` a defensible alternative to `partial`; I chose `partial` because dimension ≤5 with κ≥0, ν≤1 is a genuine, fully-settled restriction of the exact stated question (klt/lc, K nef ⇒ semiample), which is what §3.1 defines as a case rather than a bound. A second competing reading is that the slc-Kähler dispute (arXiv:2604.28085) is close enough to klt that it should be logged as a near-miss `progress`/`incident` rather than excluded entirely — I judged slc to be a strictly different (broader) singularity hypothesis than klt, per the standard MMP hierarchy (klt ⇒ dlt ⇒ lc; slc is the non-normal analogue of lc), so it is a related problem under §3.1, not a case.
what_would_settle_it: A published, expert-digested proof of abundance for klt (or even just lc) projective varieties in arbitrary dimension over characteristic 0 would resolve the whole conjecture (`resolved`). Short of that, a case-settlement in a strictly higher dimension than 5, or removing the ν≤1 restriction in Liu–Xu's framework, would be further `partial` progress worth a fresh record.

judgement.doubts: The all-dimension ν≤1 statement is conditional on non-vanishing (scope none); only the dim ≤5 unconditional part is a case. Record says the lc case uses a refinement from Lazić–Peternell. Other events are other characteristics, Kähler category or slc singularities: variants.
